payload.summary: A review bot (Gitar) armed auto-merge on a clinical-risk PR and it merged on bot approval alone, with no human review
payload.detail: Decide whether bot-enabled auto-merge should be allowed on PRs that touch the clinical-risk list (e.g. patient-safety-plan.tsx), and if not, turn off Gitar auto-merge or require a human approval via branch protection. Why: PR 3507 changed a patient-safety component and was squash-merged by gitar-bot at 2026-10-13 04:24 after only bot approvals; AGENTS.md treats auto-merge state as user-owned. Context: the owner had not armed it; the session could not disable it without breaking that rule. Owner: user. Confidence: high.
